recommendation: Advance Paraformer Small INT8 to guarded dialogue integration and real speech verification; no production acceptance or deployment implied by this offline screen.
scope: Eight identical public synthetic WAVs, 2.28–3.72 seconds each; two rounds per model, three CPU threads, nice 0, one additional isolated model process at a time; camera/GUI/memory workers retained, microphone already paused at entry.
first_attempt_note: Stopped before any model slot or listening mutation because entry state was already paused. Parent then preserved entry preference and completed the public comparison. No model load failure is implied.

observed_comparison.interpretation: Small had lower wall time in all 16 paired decodes and substantially lower process CPU and peak RSS. This supports a promising candidate on KV260. Fixed order, small synthetic set and changing background activity prevent treating exact percentages as controlled causal or guaranteed production gains.

quality_limit: Authored synthetic intents are not human-gold transcripts. 107 normalized characters repeated twice are not 214 independent samples. Literal edit distance 4/214 versus 6/214 does not establish general accuracy superiority. No real voice, dialect, noise or false-trigger acceptance.

final_state.interpretation: Public test left pre-existing paused state unchanged. The operating window subsequently reported the user explicitly confirmed manual pause. Preserve that preference; no automatic-listening restoration is claimed for this pair.

followup: Original optimization owner receives this evidence to plan minimal reversible integration while preserving identity, permissions, memory semantics and normal audio ACK/rearm. Any faster complete-dialogue claim needs a real end-to-end test.
